insight: Built AI-native from the ledger up, it auto-categorizes up to 98% of transactions so burn and runway update in real time, not at month-end.
name: Puzzle
tagline: AI-native accounting software for startups and their accountants.
description: Puzzle is an AI-native general ledger for startups that converts transaction data from tools like Stripe, Mercury, Ramp, and Brex into reconciled financial statements continuously. Its AI automates up to 98% of categorization, keeping burn and runway current in real time, and supports both cash and accrual accounting from one ledger.

modelSupport.notes: Custom AI categorization trained on the user's transaction patterns.
